;Loading SORT 12

(sort '("this" "is" "a" "test") 'alphalessp)
;; this eats CPU time, but never returns. 

;; even after all this

(sort '(|this| |is| |a| |test|) 'alphalessp)
(/a |is| |test| |this|)

;; so something is wrong in the string package.

;; also, alphalessp of strings seems to work.
